hypotheses.explanation: PaymentService Charge emits “Payment charge failed” and returns gRPC INTERNAL; the checkout request error explicitly propagates that charge failure.
PlaceOrder records an ERROR and returns INTERNAL during the failed checkout, though telemetry indicates the payment charge error is the underlying cause.
Some frontend GetProduct client spans take about 65–87 ms while the corresponding product-catalog server spans are under 1 ms, consistent with intermittent latency on this edge.
